caption: A row of mature deciduous trees along the Ballyduff Road approach, looking out away from the village. A beautiful established avenue that does a lot of work for the streetscape coming into Two-Mile-Borris from the north (May 2026)

Looking back toward the village from the Ballyduff Road approach. Mature trees on both sides, a Birch on the left and the avenue continuing on the right with topiary at the granite-pillar wall. The whole stretch frames the village really well as you come in from the north (May 2026)
